subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “At first, people did not buy it.”?
options: Her brother thought their father ate it.
Some students thought it was too plain.
Camp is not as scary as I thought.
They thought ugly fruit must taste bad.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Her brother thought their father ate it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some students thought it was too plain.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Camp is not as scary as I thought.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「At first, people did not buy it. They thought ugly fruit must taste bad.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「At first, people did not buy it. They thought ugly fruit must taste bad.」，答案為「They thought ugly fruit must taste bad.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They thought ugly fruit must taste bad.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
